info.description:
Welcome to the Tatoeba API

This is an ongoing effort to provide an API for tatoeba.org. This API is currently read-only, but open to the public without authentification. Feedback is welcome.

Endpoints can be divided in two categories.

  • Stable endpoints use the /v1 prefix: it is safe to build upon them.
  • Unstable endpoints use the /unstable prefix: these may change at any point in the future, in terms of behavior, required parameters or response format.
As work on this API progresses, some unstable endpoints will become stable by switching the prefix from /unstable to /v1. For backward compatibility, all /v1 endpoints can also be used with /unstable prefix instead.

get.description:
Allows to search for sentences based on some criteria. By default, all sentences are returned, including sentences you might want to filter out, such as unapproved or orphaned (that is, likely not proofread) ones. To filter sentences, use any combination of the parameters described below.

Combining sentence filters

Use & (the usual operator to combine query parameters) to combine filters with logical AND.

ExampleResult
lang=epo
&has_audio=yes		 Only sentences both in Esperanto and having audio.
tag=OK
&tag=colloquial		 Only sentences having both an OK tag and a colloquial tag.

Use , to combine several values of a filter with logical OR.

ExampleResult
lang=srp,hrv,bos Only sentences in Serbian, Croatian, or Bosnian.
tag=idiom,proverb Only sentences tagged as idiom or proverb (or both).

Use ! as value prefix to make a logical NOT (applied to the entire list of values). It can be used to exclude sentences matched by the filter.

ExampleResult
tag=!colloquial Exclude sentences tagged as colloquial.
tag=!idiom,proverb Exclude sentences tagged as idiom or proverb or both. (In other words, only sentences neither tagged as idiom nor proverb.)
tag=!idiom
&tag=!proverb		 Exclude sentences that are both tagged as idiom and proverb. (Should a sentence be tagged as idiom but not proverb, it won't be excluded.)

Combining translation filters

Translation filters are filters which name starts with trans: (or !trans:, covered later).

ExampleResult
trans:lang=epo
&trans:is_direct=yes		 Only sentences having direct translation(s) in Esperanto.
trans:lang=epo
&trans:owner=gillux		 Only sentences having translation(s) in Esperanto owned by "gillux".
trans:count=0 Only sentences not having any translation at all.

Each translation filter belongs to a group. First, filters belonging to the same group are applied together to the translations with a logical AND, and then each group result is combined with a logical AND.

Filters starting with the same prefix belong to the same group, and trans: is just one of these groups. It is possible to create any number of groups using the prefix trans:n:, n consisting of one or more digits.

ExampleResult
trans:1:lang=epo
&trans:2:lang=sun		 Only sentences both having translation(s) in Esperanto and in Sundanese.
trans:1:lang=epo
&trans:1:owner=gillux
&trans:2:lang=sun
&trans:2:owner=ajip		 Only sentences both having translation(s) in Esperanto owned by "gillux" and in Sundanese owned by "ajip".
trans:1:lang=epo
&trans:1:is_orphan=yes
&trans:2:lang=epo
&trans:2:is_orphan=no		 Only sentences both having orphan and non-orphan translation(s) in Esperanto.

By prefixing a group number n with an exclamation mark, it is possible to perform a logical NOT on a specific group before it is combined with other groups. This can be used to exclude sentences having translation(s) matched by the group.

ExampleResult
trans:1:lang=epo
&trans:1:is_direct=no		 Only sentences having indirect translation(s) in Esperanto.
trans:!1:lang=epo
&trans:!1:is_direct=yes		 Exclude sentences having direct translation(s) in Esperanto.
trans:1:lang=epo
&trans:1:is_direct=no
&trans:!1:lang=epo
&trans:!1:is_direct=yes		 Combination of the two above: only sentences having indirect, but not any direct translation(s) in Esperanto (note that trans:1: and trans:!1: are considered as different groups because the prefix is not strictly equal).
trans:!1:lang=epo
&trans:!2:lang=sun		 Exclude sentences having translation(s) in Esperanto or Sundanese (or both). Why or? Because in boolean algebra: !epo AND !sun ⟺ !(epo OR sun)

Note that groups such as trans:1: are not a subgroup of the trans: group; they are all groups of the same level.

Special !trans: prefix

The prefix !trans: works just like trans:, except it is a separate group of groups in which a final logical NOT is performed on the top of all the groups it encompasses. This can be used to exclude sentences having translations matched by several groups at once.

ExampleResult
!trans:1:lang=epo
&!trans:2:lang=sun		 Exclude sentences both having translation(s) in Esperanto and in Sundanese.
!trans:1:lang=epo
&!trans:1:owner=gillux
&!trans:2:lang=sun
&!trans:2:owner=ajip		 Exclude sentences both having translation(s) in Esperanto owned by "gillux" and in Sundanese owned by "ajip".
!trans:1:lang=epo
&!trans:1:is_orphan=yes
&!trans:2:lang=epo
&!trans:2:is_orphan=no		 Exclude sentences both having orphan and non-orphan translation(s) in Esperanto.

!trans: can also be used as an equivalent prefix for trans:!0: when this would otherwise be the only group.

ExampleResult
trans:0:lang=epo
&trans:!0:lang=sun		 Sentences having translation(s) in Esperanto and not having any translation in Sundanese.
trans:lang=epo
&!trans:lang=sun		 Same as above.

Returned translations

By default, this endpoint only returns translations matched by translations filters.

ExampleReturned sentencesReturned translations
lang=eng English sentences. None.
lang=eng
&trans:lang=jav		 English sentences having translation(s) in Javanese. Javanese translations.
lang=eng
&trans:is_direct=no		 English sentences having indirect translation(s). Indirect translations.
lang=eng
&trans:lang=jav
&trans:is_direct=yes		 English sentences having indirect translation(s) in Javanese Indirect Javanese translations.

Note that only non-excluding translation filters are taken into account.

ExampleReturned sentencesReturned translations
lang=eng
&!trans:lang=jav		 English sentences not having any translations in Javanese. None.
lang=eng
&trans:!1:lang=jav		 Same as above. None.
lang=eng
&trans:lang=!jav		 English sentences having translations not in Javanese. Translations not in Javanese.

This behavior is what happens when using the parameter showtrans=matching, which is the default value for showtrans. You may also use showtrans=all or showtrans=none to respectively return all or no translations, regardless of the translation filters in use.

Alternatively, you can manually specify a custom set of criteria to filter returned translations by using parameters starting with showtrans:. These parameters work the same way as translation filters, and support group filters.

ExampleReturned sentencesReturned translations
lang=eng
&trans:lang=pol
&showtrans:lang=mar		 English sentences having translation(s) in Polish. Translations in Marathi (if any).
lang=eng
&trans:lang=pol
&showtrans:lang=!mar		 English sentences having translation(s) in Polish. Translations not in Marathi (if any).
lang=eng
&trans:lang=pol
&showtrans:is_direct=yes
&showtrans:is_native=yes		 English sentences having translation(s) in Polish. Direct translations owned by native speakers (if any).
lang=eng
&trans:lang=pol
&showtrans:1:lang=mar
&showtrans:1:is_direct=yes
&showtrans:2:lang=jav
&showtrans:2:is_native=yes		 English sentences having translation(s) in Polish. Both direct translations in Marathi and translations in Javanese owned by native speakers (if any).
lang=eng
&trans:lang=pol
&!showtrans:lang=mar		 Error, invalid showtrans filter.
lang=eng
&trans:lang=pol
&showtrans:!1:lang=mar		 Error, invalid showtrans filter.
